text: Siemens AG is a Frankfurt-listed industrial group. Per its own Siemens Report for fiscal 2025, 'The von Siemens-Vermögensverwaltung GmbH (vSV) has, on a sustained basis, powers of attorney allowing it to exercise the voting rights for 9,487,101 Siemens shares (as of September 30, 2025) on behalf of members of the Siemens family' -- about 1.2% of the roughly 800 million shares outstanding. No state shareholder is named in the report.

source.name: Siemens AG, Siemens Report fiscal 2025
source.quote: The von Siemens-Vermögensverwaltung GmbH (vSV) has, on a sustained basis, powers of attorney allowing it to exercise the voting rights for 9,487,101 Siemens shares
